name: CECEP Environmental Protection Co., Ltd.
summary: CECEP Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. engages in the energy-saving and environmental protection equipment and electrical special equipment business worldwide. The company is involved in the research, design, development, manufacturing, sale, and service of treatment equipment for multiple processes of sewage treatment, including urban sewage, tap water, industrial wastewater, sludge treatment and disposal, garbage, kitchen leachate treatment, and rural sewage treatment. It also provides waste incineration power generation equipment; environmental pollution prevention and control equipment; and transformer special equipment and transformer core, such as shearing equipment, transformer coil…
